heroImageAlt: A beautiful sunset over the glowing ocean.
heroDescription: Lorne Lieberman, LMFT provides high-end, bespoke psychotherapy for individuals and couples seeking real and lasting change in their lives.
philosophyTitleLine1: Therapy is not merely about gaining tools to cope. It is about
philosophyTitleLine3: cultivating the mind to wakeup to the wisdom in every experience.
philosophyDescription1: This work is for those committed to life as a journey – not just strategies to cope, but a genuine shift in how you relate to your identity, your anxiety, your relationships, and what your life means.
philosophyDescription2: What happens in this room is an open conversation about what you actually want — your wishes, your fears, the parts of yourself you haven’t been able to face yet. You leave with more  than tools. You leave with choice.

aboutParagraph1: Born into a Hollywood film and television family, my early landscape was one of narratives and the complex machinery of human emotion. This background instilled in me a deep, editorial understanding of the human condition—the stories we tell ourselves and the truths we often hide.
aboutParagraph2: My path to clinical practice was informed by a decade spent as a mystic monk, yogi, and Buddhist. This spiritual lineage, with its deep connections to Sufism and Vedantic traditions, provides the contemplative bedrock for my therapeutic work. I bring a profound, meditative presence to the clinical space, bridging the gap between ancient wisdom and modern psychological science.
aboutParagraph3: As a licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, I provide a secure, empathetic environment where deep exploration can occur. My approach is highly individualized, recognizing that each person's path to healing and success is entirely their own.
service1Description: Deep, exploratory work integrating EMDR, Relational Psychoanalysis, and mindfulness based Buddhist Psychology for adults navigating anxiety, depression, and the fragmentation of modern identity.
service2Description: Restoring intimacy and communication utilizing the Gottman Method and relational frameworks.
service3Description: Discreet psychological advisory for high-performing professionals and creatives.
ratesDescription1: Bespoke therapy is an investment in your long-term psychological well-being. Sessions are typically 50 minutes in duration, though extended sessions can be arranged for deep-dive clinical work.
ratesDescription2: While I do not directly accept insurance, I am happy to provide monthly superbills for you to submit to your provider for out-of-network reimbursement. Many clients receive significant coverage depending on their specific plan.
footerDescription: Accepting a limited number of new clients for bespoke therapeutic engagements.
